titleZh: 敏銳 ↔ 愚鈍｜手術刀對橡皮槌
hook: acumen／adroit 是手術刀，asinine／crass／obtuse 是橡皮槌——同一題，切開或敲平。
script: 敏銳隊：acumen／acuity／adroit／astute／perspicacious。愚鈍隊：asinine／crass／obtuse／dense。口令：刀寫洞察，槌寫「我聽不懂但很大聲」。

members.senseAnchor: the ability to make good judgements and quick decisions
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 手術刀: acumen walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「手術刀」出場：acumen 一上場梗就黏住——洞察力。

members.senseAnchor: sharpness of vision; the visual ability to resolve fine detail (usually measured by a Snellen chart); a quick and penetrating intelligence
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 對焦環: acuity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「對焦環」出場：acuity 一上場梗就黏住——敏銳。

members.senseAnchor: quick or skillful or adept in action or thought
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 巧手: adroit walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「巧手」出場：adroit 一上場梗就黏住——靈巧敏捷的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鷹眼: astute walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鷹眼」出場：astute 一上場梗就黏住——精明的。

members.senseAnchor: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence; used of persons
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 算盤精: shrewd walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「算盤精」出場：shrewd 一上場梗就黏住——精明的。

related.synonyms: astute, sharp, calculating, calculative, conniving, scheming

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 驢口罩: asinine walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「驢口罩」出場：asinine 一上場梗就黏住——愚蠢的。

members.senseAnchor: so crude and unrefined as to be lacking in discrimination and sensibility
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 橡皮槌: crass walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「橡皮槌」出場：crass 一上場梗就黏住——粗俗愚鈍的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鈍角帽: obtuse walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鈍角帽」出場：obtuse 一上場梗就黏住——遲鈍的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 水泥腦: dense walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「水泥腦」出場：dense 一上場梗就黏住——愚鈍的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鈍刀: dull walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鈍刀」出場：dull 一上場梗就黏住——遲鈍的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 傻笑瓶: fatuous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「傻笑瓶」出場：fatuous 一上場梗就黏住——愚昧的。

members.senseAnchor: not elegant or graceful in expression; generally incompetent and ineffectual
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 反手控: inept walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「反手控」出場：inept 一上場梗就黏住——笨拙的。

related.synonyms: awkward, clumsy, cumbersome, inapt, ill-chosen, feckless

members.speakLineZh: 請「槌子」出場：mallet 一上場梗就黏住——槌子。

members.speakLineZh: 請「鏡頭」出場：lens 一上場梗就黏住——鏡頭。
